cityArabicNames.notes: Arabic alternate names joined by city coordinates; original name retained where no Arabic alternate exists. Palestinian city catalog sourced from GeoNames.

currency.notes: ISO 4217 minor units. MRU supersedes obsolete MRO in the city catalog. Palestine has no automatic settlement currency; business must choose ILS, JOD or USD.

countryNames: Unicode CLDR Arabic display names; requested product display name Palestine / فلسطين. ISO country identifiers remain unchanged.
boundaries: Each ISO code has its own .source.json attribution, license and pinned download URL. Generalized geographic data is not a legal border determination.

countryCityCatalog.notes: Controlled catalog of cities above 15,000 population, supplemented by existing legacy EG/JO/IQ identifiers. City points are not service boundaries. Country names from CLDR; calling codes validated by libphonenumber; time zones use IANA identifiers.
